board: Adafruit LIS3DH Triple-Axis Accelerometer breakout, STEMMA QT version (#2809), main 6-pin header VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, INT
reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico on the first run (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test X=0.500 Y=-0.300 Z=1.200 g, circuit board DRC clean, footprint, LCSC C15134). The sim stores OUT_X/Y/Z as left-justified 12-bit two's complement, low byte first, at 1 mg/digit (HR mode, ±2 g), with WHO_AM_I 0x33 and the data also at 0xA8-0xAD to model the datasheet's 0x80 auto-increment sub-address. Only the board's main header row is modelled; the second row (I2, A3, A2, A1, SDO, CS) is optional for I2C.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://cdn-learn.adafruit.com/assets/assets/000/094/436/medium800/sensors_LIS3DH_fab_print.png (Adafruit fab print: 1 VCC/VIN, 2 3.3V/3Vo, 3 GND, 4 SCL, 5 SDA, 6 INT1) and the board photo on https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-lis3dh-triple-axis-accelerometer-breakout/pinouts
